blocks.text: The reality of your daily tax practice

Your day often feels like a series of interruptions. You start with a plan to finish a complex tax return in Excel, but you end up answering emails or chasing client signatures. This context switching kills your momentum. You rely on tools like QuickBooks Online, Xero, or TaxDome to manage your practice. When these tools do not talk to each other, you end up manually moving data between tabs. This is where tax return automation in Excel becomes a necessity rather than a luxury.
Using voice to speed up Excel workflows

Excel remains the backbone of your tax modeling. When you have a massive workbook open, finding a specific cell or applying a formula can take time. Instead of hunting through the ribbon menu, ask Lazur to point out the features you need. Hold the Option and Command keys to ask where a specific tool is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button on your screen. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the data.
If you are working with sensitive tax data, always follow your firm's internal data protection policies. Lazur does not store your content or train models on your files.
blocks.title: Privacy and data security

blocks.text: Email is often the biggest source of reactive work. You spend hours typing the same explanations about tax filings or document requests. Use the dictation feature in Lazur to draft these emails faster. Hold the fn key to start dictating clean, formatted text directly into Outlook or Gmail. You can create snippets for common client questions to avoid typing the same text repeatedly.

blocks.text: How to get started with Lazur

Start by identifying the tasks you repeat every day. Do you open the same three websites to check tax news? Ask Lazur to open them for you. Do you struggle to find a specific setting in Excel? Ask Lazur to guide you. By offloading these small, annoying tasks, you reclaim time for the work that actually matters to your clients.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my tax forms for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It helps you navigate your apps and draft text, but you remain in control of every calculation and entry.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for client data?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen and hears your voice while you hold the shortcut key. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models. You should always follow your firm's specific rules regarding client data.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is designed specifically for macOS. There is no version for Windows at this time.
